newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Captall plans 563 mln rand rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Captall plans 563 mln rand rights issue.

text.p: Capital Alliance Holdings Ltd -- a key player in the in the black empowerment bid for control of mining house JCI Ltd -- said on Monday it would proceed with a rights issue to raise 563.11 million rand before expenses.
A total of 22.98 million new shares will be offered at a price of 24.50 rand on the basis of 24 new shares for every 100 held.
Last day to register for the offer is February 28.

The African Mining Group -- which groups Capital Alliance Holdings Ltd, African Renaissance Holdings and Khotso Investments among others -- agreed last November to buy a 34.9 percent stake in JCI from Anglo American Corp for 2.88 billon rand or 54.40 rand per share.
The deal gives black business a significant stake in the South African mining industry for the first time.
